founders.bio: Zaky is a protein biochemist and viral structural biologist who has characterized mechanisms of antibody neutralization in human pathogenic coronaviruses. She has an undergraduate degree in Biophysics (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto and she has published in Nature Microbiology and Nature Communications.
